tagline: Leading Colombian financial conglomerate providing banking, pension fund management, and investment services
hero_kpi_rationale: The 7.5% net income growth demonstrates operational strength and profitability of the Colombian financial conglomerate. This KPI reflects the group's ability to generate value across its multiple segments (pension fund management, commercial banking, asset management) and its dominant position in the Colombian market.

kpis.name: Net Income Growth
kpis.explanation: Annual growth rate of net income from all operating segments.
kpis.description: Net income increased from Ps 654.1 billion in 2024 to Ps 703.1 billion in 2025, reflecting strong performance across pension management and trading segments.
kpis.signal: Solid profitability growth driven by pension fund management and investment portfolio performance.

kpis.name: Pension Fee Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth in commission and fee income from pension and severance fund management.
kpis.description: Pension and severance fund management fees grew from Ps 1,174.0 billion in 2024 to Ps 1,281.4 billion in 2025, driven by 16% growth in severance fund AUMs, 5.3% increase in mandatory contributions, and 17% growth in voluntary pension fund AUMs.
kpis.signal: Robust growth in core pension management business driven by AUM expansion and higher contributions.

kpis.name: Net Trading Income Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth in net trading income from investment securities and derivatives.
kpis.description: Net trading income increased from Ps 256.5 billion in 2024 to Ps 298.3 billion in 2025, driven by improved performance of the stabilization reserve (Ps 266.9 billion) and positive derivative trading results.
kpis.signal: Strong capital markets performance benefiting from favorable investment conditions in 2025.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Combined balance sheet assets of the financial conglomerate.
kpis.description: Total assets and equity increased from Ps 327.9 billion in 2024 to Ps 348.9 billion in 2025, indicating continued financial strength.
kpis.signal: Substantial asset growth reflecting balance sheet expansion and market confidence.

kpis.name: Customer Deposits
kpis.explanation: Total customer deposits across all banking subsidiaries, primary source of retail and corporate funding.
kpis.description: Customer deposits increased from Ps 200.9 billion in 2024 to Ps 207.4 billion in 2025, demonstrating customer confidence and stable funding.
kpis.signal: Stable and growing deposit base reflecting market trust in the banking group.

kpis.name: Commission & Fee Income
kpis.explanation: Total net income from commissions and fees across all business segments.
kpis.description: Net income from commissions and fees increased from Ps 1,074.7 billion in 2024 to Ps 1,165.5 billion in 2025, driven primarily by pension fund management and banking services.
kpis.signal: Broad-based fee income growth across pension management and banking services.

kpis.name: Impairment Loss Recovery
kpis.explanation: Reduction in net impairment losses on financial assets year-over-year.
kpis.description: Net impairment loss on financial assets decreased from Ps 6.8 billion in 2024 to Ps 3.4 billion in 2025, reflecting improved portfolio quality and lower credit losses.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in asset quality with 49.9% reduction in impairment losses.

kpis.name: Personnel Expense Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year increase in personnel costs including salaries and employee benefits.
kpis.description: Personnel expenses increased from Ps 185.9 billion in 2024 to Ps 197.6 billion in 2025, with 7.6% increase in salaries and employee benefits.
kpis.signal: Controlled personnel cost growth driven by salary increases and business expansion.

risks.title: Regulatory dependency on the Financial Superintendence
risks.score_rationale: Major risk located at the beginning of the document (Item 1A). Intensive language: "subject to inspection and surveillance", "comprehensive supervision", "required to comply". Stable trend but structural. High category weight: all Colombian subsidiaries directly supervised.

risks.title: Geographic concentration and economic exposure to Colombia
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in forward-looking statements ("changes in Colombian, regional and international business and economic, political or other conditions"). Moderate but repeated language. Trend up: decline in oil sector mentioned. Very high category weight: majority of assets in Colombia.

risks.title: Customer portfolio concentration risk and credit defaults
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in forward-looking statements ("increases in defaults by our customers"). Financial data shows significant impairment loss (Ps 4,268.2B in 2025). Stable trend but sensitive to economic cycles. Critical category weight for a bank.

risks.title: Risk of goodwill and intangible assets impairment
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements ("increases in goodwill impairment losses, or other impairments"). Moderate language. Stable trend but relevant post-acquisitions (MFG, integrations). Medium category weight for financial holding.

risks.title: Risk of deposit erosion and customer attrition
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned ("decreases in deposits, customer loss or revenue loss"). Direct language. Trend up: increasing banking competition in Colombia and fintech. Critical category weight: deposits = primary funding source.

risks.title: Interest rate volatility risk and margin compression
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements ("changes in interest rates which may, among other effects, adversely affect margins"). Intensive language. Trend up: Colombian Central Bank in normalization cycle. Very high category weight: direct impact on NII.

risks.title: Risk of unsuccessful integration of acquisitions and subsidiaries
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned ("successful integration and future performance of acquired businesses or assets"). Moderate language. Stable trend but relevant: MFG sale in 2026 (Ps 1,719.7B), prior integrations. Medium category weight.

risks.title: Risk of losing key management personnel
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned at the end of forward-looking statements ("loss of any key member of our senior management"). Moderate language. Stable trend. Low category weight for diversified holding but not negligible.

ai_positioning.summary: AVAL adopts a conservative approach to artificial intelligence, focusing on incremental technology investments to support operational efficiency in pension fund management and banking services without announcing transformative AI initiatives.
evidence: No mention of generative AI or large language models in 2025 Form 20-F
Technology investments directed toward pension fund platform optimization and banking infrastructure
No disclosed AI-driven product launches or dedicated AI revenue streams
Focus on regulatory compliance and risk management systems rather than AI innovation
